order: Staff the five remaining evidence-band seats with six role files altogether. Scout, Researcher, LC Analyst, Investigator and Archivist each ship, though Archivist splits into two lane files, documents and images, since each lane is its own single casting with no mirror rung. Rename the Scout file so it never collides with the existing top-level scout file already in the repository, and carry the Investigator's tool restriction to reads over from the alias it is built from, leaving that restriction unchanged. For Researcher and LC Analyst, ship the primary launcher file for now and leave the mirror rung unshipped, but record that gap explicitly in the roster ledger rather than skip it silently. Update the roster README and its ledger entry to capture every naming and rung decision made in this stage. Leave exercising and reviewing these seats for a later stage of the same band.
